strings.19340c140e9e:
Author: Godes, Emili
Date: 1942
Description: In the drawing room of a palace, Riaza, Bráñez, Doña O, Rosario, Venancio, and Garviza and Hernando are seated in a rough circle around a small table. They are all focused on Garviza, who looks frightened. They are still wearing their hats and jackets. Poveda is standing between Doña O and Rosario. The image captures the moment when the travelers listen to the sad story of Garviza and the curse said to have haunted the place since her son's death. Hernando is particularly interested in it as a potential plot for one of his novels; furthermore, he believes it is a theatrical performance staged specifically to entertain them during their journey.
